object: Weco AIDE2 / SpecBench held-out harness-selection law

authority: Explicit user instruction to keep the donor loop empirical, convergent and moving; repository research/evaluation tooling only.
residue: This proves the selection/acceptance law on a deterministic bounded specimen, not that an LLM can improve its own harness.

one_next: After PR #749 or an equivalent pinned local-model substrate is available, run the broad Weco packet on the same model and task budget across at least two harness modes; otherwise keep it REPLICATE.
stop: Do not expand this into autonomous harness search, held-out feedback loops, model-weight mutation, or a new research scheduler.
